{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to realizing the full promise of the Americans with Disabilities Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect and expand the right of Americans with disabilities to get the accommodations and support they need to live in integrated community settings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will improve access to meaningful and gainful employment for people with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will provide tax relief to help the millions of families caring for aging relatives or family members with chronic illnesses or disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will continue to fight for ratification of the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats know that the nation, communities, and lives are made stronger and richer by faith in many forms and the countless acts of justice, mercy, and tolerance it inspires.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe in lifting up and valuing the good work of people of faith and religious organizations and finding ways to support that work where possible.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
